findings.claim: The agent lint does not fail when `model` is a non-scalar list, allowing an invalid model field to bypass the allowed-model check.
findings.evidence: Acceptance 2.1 requires a model alias check, and the spec says lint SHALL fail for "a model other than `opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku`, `fable` or `inherit`"; the code only validates `model` inside `if (typeof fm["model"] === "string" && !MODELS.has(fm["model"]))`, while the required-field check accepts arrays via `asList(fm[field]).length`.
findings.suggested_fix: Require `model` to be a scalar string and reject arrays or empty/non-allowed values, e.g. `if (typeof fm["model"] !== "string" || !MODELS.has(fm["model"])) ...`.

findings.claim: The model policy registry is not aligned with the documented roster because it includes Qwen models for the `t4` and `l4` lanes instead of the current Opus/Sonnet/Haiku family.
findings.evidence: The spec requirement says `.kbd-orchestrator/project.json` `model_policy.registry` SHALL reference the current model family "Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5", consistent with the agent files; the diff adds `t4`/`l4` entries such as `"Qwen3.5-9B-Q8_0"`, `"Qwen3.5-27B-Q4"`, and `"Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Q4"` under `model_policy.registry`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either change all registry lanes to the current Claude family required by the spec, or amend the OpenSpec requirement and acceptance criteria to explicitly allow non-roster self-hosted models for `t4`/`l4`.
